email_outbox_kind.name: email_outbox_kind

receptionist_settings.default: '{"enabled":true,"greeting":"Hello! How can I help you find a service or book an appointment?","instructions":"","faqs":[],"allowAvailability":true,"allowBooking":true}'::jsonb

workspaces_booking_policy.name: workspaces_booking_policy
workspaces_booking_policy.value: "workspaces"."lead_hours" between 0 and 168 and "workspaces"."horizon_days" between 1 and 365 and "workspaces"."cancel_hours" between 0 and 168 and "workspaces"."slot_minutes" in (15,30,60)
